parts.name: Foot Pad
parts.Basic_description: The foot pad of the trashcan is a small metallic lever located at the bottom front, typically made of stainless steel for durability.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the pedal mechanism that, when pressed by foot, lifts the lid of the trashcan through a linkage system.
parts.Movement_description: It moves rotationally or linearly downward when pressed and returns to its original position when released.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is the top cover of the trashcan, made of durable plastic to resist corrosion and provide a lightweight closure.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the opening of the trashcan to contain odors and waste, opening automatically when the foot pad is pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates upward around a hinge axis when the pedal is pressed and closes by gravity or spring return.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the trashcan, typically made of stainless steel for strength and easy cleaning.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the trash bag and provides structural support for the lid and pedal mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, serving as the fixed housing for the moving parts.
